mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_DISSAT_S ( UNQ_KY_VAL, TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, DIVS_CD, PPCD, SAP_SNO, OCCR_DY, PRCDOC_NO, PRCDOC_NM, TST_BSS_CTT, TST_HMDPT_NM, CHKPR_ID, CHKPR_FNM, TST_DSSTN_CTT, MNMT_CTT, NOTN_NO, PBLSH_DY, WRK_SCTN_NM, TSP_CTT, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, DLT_YN ) VALUES ( #{UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{DIVS_CD}, #{PPCD}, #{SAP_SNO}, #{OCCR_DY}, #{PRCDOC_NO}, #{PRCDOC_NM}, #{TST_BSS_CTT}, #{TST_HMDPT_NM}, #{CHKPR_ID}, #{CHKPR_FNM}, #{TST_DSSTN_CTT}, #{MNMT_CTT}, #{NOTN_NO}, #{PBLSH_DY}, #{WRK_SCTN_NM}, #{TSP_CTT}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT UNQ_KY_VAL, TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, DIVS_CD, PPCD, SAP_SNO, OCCR_DY, PRCDOC_NO, PRCDOC_NM, TST_BSS_CTT, TST_HMDPT_NM, CHKPR_ID, CHKPR_FNM, TST_DSSTN_CTT, MNMT_CTT, NOTN_NO, PBLSH_DY, WRK_SCTN_NM, TSP_CTT, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, DLT_YN, TO_CHAR(A.RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT FROM GE_MP_DISSAT_S A WHERE UNQ_KY_VAL = #{UNQ_KY_VAL}
mapper.update: UPDATE GE_MP_DISSAT_S SET SAP_SNO = #{SAP_SNO}, OCCR_DY = #{OCCR_DY}, PRCDOC_NO = #{PRCDOC_NO}, PRCDOC_NM = #{PRCDOC_NM}, TST_BSS_CTT = #{TST_BSS_CTT}, TST_HMDPT_NM = #{TST_HMDPT_NM}, CHKPR_ID = #{CHKPR_ID}, CHKPR_FNM = #{CHKPR_FNM}, TST_DSSTN_CTT = #{TST_DSSTN_CTT}, MNMT_CTT = #{MNMT_CTT}, NOTN_NO = #{NOTN_NO}, PBLSH_DY = #{PBLSH_DY}, WRK_SCTN_NM = #{WRK_SCTN_NM}, TSP_CTT = #{TSP_CTT}, REGPR_ID = #{REGPR_ID}, REGPR_NM = #{REGPR_NM}, RG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE UNQ_KY_VAL = #{UNQ_KY_VAL}
